overview:
Raven Expert Consulting is a London-based boutique expert network specializing in PE due diligence for European mid-market transactions. Founded in 2019, the company takes a white-glove approach — providing highly curated, deal-specific expert access with senior staff involved in every engagement.

The boutique model trades volume for quality, making Raven appealing to mid-market PE firms who value depth of service over breadth of platform.
